title: Setup wizard
failed: Setup failed; review the candidate and retry.
passwordPolicy: Enter the current password and a different new password of at least 12 characters.
pppoeHelp: Choose a physical WAN port reserved for PPPoE. Enter the ISP username and an existing password/<name> secret reference. Setup creates the logical setup-pppoe WAN for NAT and filtering; the password itself is never entered here.
defaultsHelp: Enable outbound NAT and stateful LAN forwarding, block unsolicited WAN traffic, and restrict management to LAN. Selected interface addressing, NAT, input ACL attachments and the setup DHCP server are overwritten. Anti-lockout remains enabled.
summaryHelp: No changes have been applied. Review the exact diff before the single confirmed commit. Password values are redacted.
rerunWarning: I understand that rerunning setup overwrites the touched sections.
confirmHelp: Reconnect through LAN and confirm before {{deadline}}; otherwise the configuration reverts.
selectInterface: Select a network interface before continuing.
interfacesFailed: Some network interfaces could not be loaded. Configured interfaces remain available.
noInterfaces: No dataplane interfaces are available. Check interface ownership and the agent connection, then retry.
pppoeRequired: Enter the ISP username and a valid password/<name> secret reference.
